alerts.title: Jersey Weather Chat: damaging gusts expected soon
alerts.body: 3 of 5 weather models show gusts of 71-82 mph in Jersey within the next 3 hours. Take care outdoors. Check gov.je for official Jersey Met warnings.

alerts.title: Jersey Weather Chat: pressure falling very rapidly
alerts.body: Pressure at Jersey Airport has fallen 6 hPa in 3 hours, a sign of a deepening storm nearby. Check gov.je for official Jersey Met warnings.
